page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation for workloads.

This configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application deployment. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a low memory-to-CPU ratio, this server offers a cost-effective option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, batch processing, and basic computational tasks where dedicated CPU execution is required without the overhead of excess memory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.s3 family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, necessitating network-attached storage for deployment. Lacking advanced vector extensions and cryptographic hardware acceleration flags in its default configuration, it represents a basic, compute-focused resource profile. The ecs.s3.medium is designed for entry-level dedicated workloads, such as lightweight web serving, utility computing, and simple batch processing tasks that require dedicated CPU execution without a large memory footprint.
